# meditative

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:modeMeditative`](gmeow-modeMeditative.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/modeMeditative>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/awareness`](../../slices/awareness.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A deliberately cultivated contemplative state — focused-attention or open-monitoring meditation, distinct from both ordinary waking and drowsiness: relaxed yet vigilant, with regulated attention. A trained mode of awareness, not a default one.
